body:
## Why

Since PR #1829, the planner produces no cost estimates; prices come only from a source. The UI still promises estimates, and the workspace header does not reflect traveller progress. Observed 2026-09-22 in a browser: `frontend/src/routes/NewTripPage.tsx:147`, `:227`, `:256`, `:337`, and `:361` promise route, travel-time, or cost estimates; `frontend/src/components/workspace/panels/RouteTradeoffsPanel.tsx:43-45` shows a flat-rates banner above “Not priced” cards; and `trip_planner/app/services/workspace_view_model.py:176-187` always returns the initial ready-state copy. “Approval is not ready yet” (`:83-85`) gives no reason or next step.

## Scope

The copy above, and `_next_step` / approval-readiness in `workspace_view_model.py`.

## Non-Goals

No redesign of the workspace; copy and state only. Do not replace one unverified claim with another.

## Tasks

- [ ] Update `frontend/src/routes/NewTripPage.tsx` copy to state that the planner measures route and travel time from the origin and the traveller supplies prices.
- [ ] Delete the flat-rates banner in `frontend/src/components/workspace/panels/RouteTradeoffsPanel.tsx:42-46`.
- [ ] Update `_next_step` in `trip_planner/app/services/workspace_view_model.py` to advance through unpriced → “Enter the prices you have” (Budget); priced, no policy → “Submit for approval”; blocked → “Fix what policy flagged” with codes; compliant → “Print the approval packet”.
- [ ] Update approval-readiness copy in `workspace_view_model.py` to state the first missing step.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `tests/app/test_workspace_view_model.py` verifies that a trip with entered prices and no proposal returns “Submit for approval”, and a blocked submission names the blocking codes; making `_next_step` ignore prices fails the test, and reverting passes.
- [ ] A `frontend` test verifies that none of the removed cost-estimate strings render on `/trips/new`.

## Implementation Notes

_Not provided._

```text
## Why

Since PR #1829 the planner produces no cost estimates; prices come only from a source. The UI still promises them, and the workspace header never moves as the traveller makes progress. Observed 2026-09-22 in a browser:

- `frontend/src/routes/NewTripPage.tsx:147` and `:361` "it will assemble route and cost options"; `:227` "distance, travel time and transport cost all depend on it"; `:256` "Dates drive cost estimates"; `:337` "Used for per-person cost estimates".
- `frontend/src/components/workspace/panels/RouteTradeoffsPanel.tsx:43-45` banner: "The figures come from flat per-day rates that do not vary by destination" — above cards that read "Not priced".
- Workspace header (`trip_planner/app/services/workspace_view_model.py:176-187`) returns "Trip setup is saved. Nothing has been planned yet." / "Look over the starting options" whenever `status == "ready"`, regardless of prices entered, policy synced or a verdict received. After pricing and submitting, the header still said nothing had been planned. "Approval is not ready yet." (`:83-85`) gives no reason and no next step.

## Scope
The copy above, and `_next_step` / approval-readiness in `workspace_view_model.py`.

## Non-Goals
- No redesign of the workspace; copy and state only.
- Do not replace one unverified claim with another.

## Tasks
- [ ] Rewrite the NewTripPage lines to say what the planner does now (measures route and travel time from the origin; the traveller supplies prices).
- [ ] Delete the flat-rates banner in `RouteTradeoffsPanel.tsx:42-46`.
- [ ] Make `_next_step` advance through: unpriced → "Enter the prices you have" (Budget); priced, no policy → "Submit for approval"; blocked → "Fix what policy flagged" with the codes; compliant → "Print the approval packet".
- [ ] Give "Approval is not ready yet" its reason (the first missing step).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] **Test gate** `tests/app/test_workspace_view_model.py`: for a trip with entered prices and no proposal, the next action is "Submit for approval"; after a blocked submission it names the blocking codes. **Deliberate break:** make `_next_step` ignore prices — gate fails; revert passes.
- [ ] `frontend` test asserts none of the removed cost-estimate strings render on `/trips/new`.
```
</details>
